acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for drywall repair in Pacifica or Daly City, look for local experience and positive references or reviews specific to drywall work. Ensure they are licensed and insured to protect yourself. Ask for a detailed estimate that outlines the scope of work, materials, and timeline. A good contractor will clearly communicate the repair process and ensure a seamless match with your existing walls.
